_comment: Generated by infra/aws-central/tools/snapshot-india-wards.mjs --index. One row per ward snapshot under data/wards/<STATE>/, with the hash of the file as committed, and the locality gazetteer. Do not edit by hand.

snapshots.vintage: Undated, and older than the numbering 2026 tenders use. The file draws 58 polygons; Kanpur Nagar Nigam has 110 wards.

use.evidence: tested: every title that gives a name beside a number the file draws gives another name than the file's (17 of 17); 20 of 23 number pairs read were wrong

snapshots.vintage: The 150 GHMC election wards. G.O.Ms.No.292 (24 Dec 2025) reorganised the area into 12 zones and 60 circles and G.O.Ms.No.55 (11 Feb 2026) constituted three corporations; a ward's name survives that, its number may not.

use.evidence: tested: titles of 2026 use a new numbering (ward 17 is Cherlapally, here ward 3); a name on the title's own ward marker was right in 5 of 5 pairs read
